name: Venators
taskNotes: Mortimer assigns Venators directly. Other masters assign the Vampyres category; Venators count for those assignments.
74 Slayer and The Blood Moon Rises are required. Only designated vampyrebane weapons deal damage.
Venators are living vampyres; Salve amulet bonuses do not apply.
Earmuffs or a Slayer helmet reduce shriek damage. Protection prayer during the shriek causes repeated damage and prayer loss.
Venators can be killed off-task by paying the nearby aranei 30 Stymphike feathers per kill.
Superior blood-starved venators can spawn with Bigger and Badder even when killing venators off-task.
recommendedMethod: Use a Sunspear or hallowed flail with Efaritay's aid and a Slayer helmet on task. Sunspear special-attack finishing blows produce hearts for the nearby Aranei shrine; ranged blisterwood stakes are an alternative with lower accuracy.
